# Phase Two Critique — Forty Refinements

The Awtsmoos tests every social vessel before another current may stream;
Awtsmoos.com grows cleaner when power submits to evidence, contract, and dream.

1. Keep `/social-hub/` canonical human UX.
2. Keep `/social/` developer observability.
3. Do not duplicate Inbox, DMs, Chat, Spaces, People, Network, or Create.
4. Reference existing `RouteModel.js` instead of duplicating route metadata.
5. Capability discovery stays retractable, not another permanent dock item.
6. Do not append markup to the oversized Social Hub HTML.
7. Mount new UI from small modules.
8. Server authorization remains authoritative.
9. A backend file does not automatically imply public mutation UI.
10. Record parity status: full, advanced, internal, planned.
11. Search capability metadata locally.
12. Navigate to owning panels instead of surprise mutation.
13. Label mutation consequences.
14. Show missing identity/context before execution.
15. Raw JSON belongs under Advanced disclosure.
16. Preserve exact API evidence for developers.
17. Preserve the existing modular `SocialHubApi` foundation.
18. Split the separate Observatory `api.js` monolith.
19. Preserve its `socialApi` compatibility facade.
20. Close the verified `feedTrending` registry gap.
21. Use existing abort/timeout transport foundations.
22. Prefer `<details>` for nonmodal disclosure.
23. Use `<dialog>` only when modal focus lifecycle is required.
24. Keep mobile primary navigation short.
25. Prevent long IDs/URLs from widening cards.
26. Motion uses transform/opacity.
27. Respect reduced motion.
28. Respect forced colors.
29. Add backend-to-frontend capability coverage tests.
30. Test intended public families, not every internal literal route.
31. Render unknown response fields safely.
32. Errors get human summaries plus exact evidence.
33. Every new selector remains under `.social-hub-document` or an owned component root.
34. No global variables or generic selectors.
35. Reuse existing focus/interaction baselines.
36. No arbitrary z-index escalation.
37. Test 320px and 390px mobile widths.
38. Make `/social/` clearly point to the full Social Hub.
39. Expand docs into capability → UI → API → auth/mutation matrix.
40. Reread every touched file because concurrent changes are possible.

## Improved decision

Wave one: a data-driven Capability Center in Social Hub, a truthful Observatory bridge, the `feedTrending` parity repair, and modular Observatory API transport. Then verify before broader expansion.
